name: blur
description: edges and fine detail softened evenly, from defocus or upscaling; not shallow depth of field on purpose

name: motion_blur
description: smearing along one direction, from camera shake or subject motion

name: noise
description: random grain or coloured speckles, most visible in flat and dark areas

name: compression
description: JPEG-like 8x8 blocking, mosquito noise around edges, smeared fine texture

name: banding
description: false contours or steps in smooth gradients such as sky, from too few levels or colours

name: overexposure
description: too bright overall or large areas blown to white with no detail

name: underexposure
description: too dark overall or shadows crushed to black with no detail

name: low_contrast
description: flat, washed-out or hazy look; blacks are grey

name: color_cast
description: an unnatural overall tint (white balance off) that the scene does not explain

name: oversaturation
description: colours unnaturally vivid, with clipped colour channels or neon skin and foliage

name: oversharpening
description: bright or dark halos along edges, crunchy amplified texture

name: aliasing
description: jagged staircase edges, moire patterns or pixelation from poor resampling

name: oversmoothing
description: waxy, plastic texture with detail painted away, typical of strong denoising

name: generative_artifacts
description: implausible structures from image generation or restoration: malformed hands, text or objects, invented texture
